justification: The counterexample violates the prime restrictions: Theorem 1.1(3) allows restricting to primes splitting completely in a suitable extension L/K, and Remark 1.1 explicitly requires splitting in the CM field ([v4](https://arxiv.org/html/1903.05032v4)). For this curve, 3 is inert in Q(i), so it is excluded. The assessment also does not identify the ground-truth failure of ad(v)-injectivity.
